text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I lost... again. I missed out on performing
center
stage... again.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I can't go on like this! I need to train
even more if
I want to win!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I am going to be a top Umadol and inspire everyone!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I am going to be a top Umadol and inspire everyone!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But I keep on losing! I can't help but feel

pressured!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wanna start winning as soon as
possible! I want
you to put my training
on Hardcore Umadol
mode!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Anyone would be surprised if their
favorite idol
suddenly started acting
differently, huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I can't allow that! An Umadol has to
treasure the
feelings of their fans!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep aiming to be the cutest top
Umadol, just
like usual!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll put my Umadol spirit on full throttle
and work
as hard as I can. Which
means...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I need you to cheer me on as hard as you
can!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. That's put some pep in my step!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No more losing! I'm going to win and put
on the
best concerts possible! ☆
